queries.prompt: Decide whether we need AWS Shield Advanced ($3,000/mo 1-year commitment) vs Shield Standard + AWS WAF, and check our `us-east-1` Shield subscription status.

Group 12 ALBs into an AWS Shield Advanced Protection Group (`SUM` aggregation) and review `list-attacks` for DDoS Cost Protection credits.
Protect an internet-facing Network Load Balancer with AWS Shield Advanced via its Elastic IP allocation ARNs.
Author an AWS WAFv2 WebACL with Bot Control Targeted rules, Fraud Control, and `x-amzn-waf-*` header stripping.
Create a Route 53 DNS Firewall rule group blocking C2 domains.
Configure AWS Direct Connect BGP BFD timers and SiteLink.
Segment Dev and Prod VPCs across separate AWS Transit Gateway route tables.
Debug why our Lambda function is timing out in a private VPC.
Write PromQL queries for Kubernetes pod memory working set vs limits.
